result:
I added item removal, discount codes and a price total to `Shop.Cart`. The code compiles with no warnings, all 19 tests pass (including doctests), and Credo (the code linter) reports no issues.

- **`remove_item/3`** subtracts units. Removing as many units as the cart holds, or more, deletes the item. A SKU (product code) that isn't in the cart leaves the cart unchanged.
- **`apply_code/2`** takes the string a customer typed. "SAVE10" and "FREESHIP" are matched exactly, so "save10" is rejected.
